sentiment_sampling: 80 per publisher sentiment class from original validation; normalized URL-stripped train overlap and internal duplicates excluded. No project training/tuning on these 240 cases. Pretrained-model overlap cannot be ruled out.
event_sampling: Builder-curated keyword-enriched examples from original topic validation, covers six classes. Not random, blinded or independently labelled. Interpretive mixed-event labels possible. No claim of representative accuracy.
dataset_card_mismatch: Sentiment card split counts differ from actual downloaded CSV counts. Actual file counts and hashes are authoritative.
